notes: TGE occurred on October 15, 2025 at 13:00 UTC.
Protocol deployment was September 15, 2025; vesting schedules for Team and Investors started from this date.
Team and Investors vesting data is fetched from on-chain VestingEscrow contracts.
Liquidity Incentives use a dynamic emission formula: Emax * sqrt(stake_rate). We track the mints onchain.
Liquidity Incentives (TBD) represents the remaining portion of the 300M allocation that has not yet been minted; scheduled distribution depends on future stake rates.
Curve Licensing emissions are dynamic and dependent on staking rates; shown as linear approximation.
Early vesting tokens (Team/Investors) are only claimable for locking into veYB before cliff ends.
Early LPs allocation shown is for Season 1.

insiders.methodology: Team and Investor allocations are claimed from VestingEscrow contracts into per-recipient CliffEscrow proxies. Both the proxies and their recipient() beneficiaries are tracked as wallets, with YB locked into veYB counted as staked. YB a proxy forwards to its beneficiary is attributed to the beneficiary's received instead of counting as transferred out of the proxy.

Liquidity Incentives.methodology: YB minted on-demand to the GaugeController when users claim gauge rewards.
